ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p (GRACEFUL SPIDER / Spandex Tempest) LEMURLOOT webshell drop on MOVEit Transfer (CVE-2023-34362)
ucs.description: Hunts for the LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) backdoor dropped on Progress MOVEit Transfer servers via the SQLi zero-day Cl0p mass-exploited in May-June 2023. The ASPX/ASHX write under the MOVEit webroot — typically authored by the MOVEit w3wp.exe app-pool worker itself — is the canonical Cl0p MFT-zero-day signature and preceded mass exfiltration of MOVEit-hosted data to their leak site.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*MOVEit*DMZ*wwwroot*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ashx" OR Filesystem.file_name="human2*" OR Filesystem.file_name="_human2*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_hash Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename process_name as writer_process | join type=left process_guid [| tstats summariesonly=true values(Processes.process) as writer_cmdline from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes by Processes.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | where writer_process IN ("w3wp.exe","MOVEitDMZ.exe","MOVEit.DMZ.WebApp.exe") OR match(file_name,"(?i)human2?") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Cl0p LEMURLOOT webshell drop on MOVEit Transfer — w3wp.exe is the SQLi-driven dropper
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\", @"\MOVEit DMZ\", @"\MOVEit\wwwroot\")
| where (FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".ashx")
   or FileName has_any ("human2","_human2","human.aspx")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
   or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","MOVEitDMZ.exe","MOVEit.DMZ.WebApp.exe")  // dropper is the MOVEit IIS worker itself
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          DropperImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          DropperCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          DropperAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          PreviousFileName, ActionType
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
    | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","whoami.exe","reg.exe")
    | project DeviceName, ChildTimestamp = Timestamp, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ChildImage = FileName
) on DeviceName
| where isempty(ChildTimestamp) or (ChildTimestamp between (Timestamp - 1h .. Timestamp + 6h))
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Cl0p LEMURLOOT webshell drop on MOVEit Transfer
// Pivots on ASIM ImFileEvent then correlates w3wp.exe child-process hands-on-keyboard
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventType in~ ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\", @"\MOVEit DMZ\", @"\MOVEit\wwwroot\")
| where TargetFileExtension in~ ("aspx","ashx")
   or TargetFileName has_any ("human2","_human2")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFilePath, TargetFileName,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername, TargetFileSHA256
| union (
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName endswith "\\w3wp.exe"
    | where NewProcessName endswith_cs any ("\\cmd.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\net.exe","\\whoami.exe","\\reg.exe","\\nltest.exe")
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname = Computer, ActingProcessName = NewProcessName,
              ActingProcessCommandLine = CommandLine, ActorUsername = SubjectUserName,
              TargetFilePath = "", TargetFileName = "", TargetFileSHA256 = ""
  )
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p (TA505 / Hive0065) Cleo MFT autorun XML → child-shell chain (CVE-2024-50623 / CVE-2024-55956)
ucs.description: Hunts the Cl0p December-2024 mass-exploit campaign against Cleo LexiCom / VLTrader / Harmony MFT products: an attacker-controlled ZIP-traversal write of a malicious XML into Cleo's autorun directory causes the Cleo Java host to spawn cmd.exe/powershell.exe, loading the Malichus / Cleopatra Java backdoor. Hits the exact initial-access → execution chain Cl0p used to breach 60+ Cleo-dependent enterprises before moving to SDBot / TrueBot follow-on tooling.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("LexiCom.exe","VLTrader.exe","Harmony.exe","Cleo.Harmony.exe") OR (Processes.parent_process_name="java.exe" AND (Processes.parent_process="*LexiCom*" OR Processes.parent_process="*VLTrader*" OR Processes.parent_process="*Harmony*" OR Processes.parent_process="*\\Cleo\\*"))) AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Cleo\\*\\autorun\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\LexiCom\\autorun\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\VLTrader\\autorun\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Harmony\\autorun\\*") AND Filesystem.file_name="*.xml" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Cl0p Cleo MFT exploit — autorun XML drop OR Cleo-spawned shell
let AutorunDrops =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Cleo\", @"\LexiCom\autorun\", @"\VLTrader\autorun\", @"\Harmony\autorun\", @"\Cleo Harmony\autorun\")
    | where FileName endswith ".xml" or FileName endswith ".tmp" or FileName endswith ".zip"
    | project AutorunTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AutorunFile = FolderPath, FileName,
              Writer = InitiatingProcessFileName, WriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let ShellSpawns =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("LexiCom.exe","VLTrader.exe","Harmony.exe","Cleo.Harmony.exe")
        or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Cleo\", @"\LexiCom\", @"\VLTrader\", @"\Harmony\")
        or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "java.exe"
            and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("LexiCom","VLTrader","Harmony",@"\Cleo\"))
    | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","net.exe","nltest.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
ShellSpawns
| join kind=leftouter AutorunDrops on DeviceName
| where isempty(AutorunTime) or (SpawnTime between (AutorunTime - 1h .. AutorunTime + 6h))
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Cl0p Cleo MFT exploit chain — autorun XML drop + Cleo-spawned shell
let AutorunDrops =
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where EventType in~ ("FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Cleo\", @"\LexiCom\autorun\", @"\VLTrader\autorun\", @"\Harmony\autorun\")
    | where TargetFileExtension in~ ("xml","tmp","zip")
    | project AutorunTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, AutorunFile = TargetFilePath,
              ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
let ShellSpawns =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName endswith_cs any ("\\LexiCom.exe","\\VLTrader.exe","\\Harmony.exe","\\Cleo.Harmony.exe")
        or (ParentProcessName endswith "\\java.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("LexiCom","VLTrader","Harmony",@"\Cleo\"))
    | where NewProcessName endswith_cs any ("\\cmd.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\rundll32.exe","\\regsvr32.exe","\\mshta.exe","\\wscript.exe","\\cscript.exe","\\certutil.exe","\\bitsadmin.exe","\\curl.exe","\\net.exe","\\nltest.exe")
    | where not(SubjectUserName endswith "$")
    | project SpawnTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname = Computer, SubjectUserName,
              ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine;
ShellSpawns
| join kind=leftouter AutorunDrops on DvcHostname
| where isempty(AutorunTime) or (SpawnTime between (AutorunTime - 1h .. AutorunTime + 6h))
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@ParentImage:(*\\LexiCom.exe OR *\\lexicom.exe OR *\\LEXICOM.EXE OR *\\VLTrader.exe OR *\\vltrader.exe OR *\\VLTRADER.EXE OR *\\Harmony.exe OR *\\harmony.exe OR *\\HARMONY.EXE OR *\\Cleo.Harmony.exe) OR (@ParentImage:(*\\java.exe OR *\\Java.exe OR *\\JAVA.EXE) AND @ParentCommandLine:(*LexiCom* OR *VLTrader* OR *Harmony* OR *\\Cleo\\* OR *\\cleo\\*))) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\Rundll32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\nltest.exe)

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ParentBaseFileName=/(lexicom|vltrader|harmony|cleo\.harmony)\.exe$/i OR (ParentBaseFileName=/java\.exe$/i AND regex("(LexiCom|VLTrader|Harmony|\\\\Cleo\\\\)", field=CommandLine)))
